AfterSideTurnStart.rationale: Akabeko.cs:23-30 applies VigorPower to its owner on AfterSideTurnStart when the owner is among the participants and PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber <= 1. The sim's on_player_turn_started is the post-draw player-turn-start slot (player.py:418), which is where audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json step 23 puts Hook.AfterSideTurnStart -- correct mapping, unlike relic/bag_of_marbles, whose C# hook is the PRE-block-clear BeforeSideTurnStart and which the sim maps to this same slot. `participants.Contains(Owner.Creature)` is the multiplayer/side filter: on_player_turn_started only ever fires for the player's own turn, so the sim's guardless call is equivalent in single-player. Turn numbering verified by execution (py audit/tools/relic_probes.py turn-order): the sim's self.turn is 1 during the first turn's hooks, so `self.turn <= 1` and `TurnNumber <= 1` select the same turn. Amount 8 matches PowerVar<VigorPower>(8m) (Akabeko.cs:19) and applier is the owner on both sides.

guards.what: N1: DynamicVars['VigorPower'].IntValue (Akabeko.cs:28) vs the sim's literal 8 (akabeko.py:22)
guards.rationale: CanonicalVars declares PowerVar<VigorPower>(8m) (Akabeko.cs:19) with no AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension call anywhere in the file, so the non-ascension value the contract pins is a constant 8. Nothing in the relic mutates the var, so hard-coding it changes nothing observable.

guards.what: N2: Flash() (Akabeko.cs:27) and the ExtraHoverTips / CanonicalVars display members
guards.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / base.Status = RelicStatus.* are presentation only (the relic card's glow and its greyed/active state in the relic bar); the sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.

guards.what: N3: `<= 1` rather than `== 1` on the turn guard, i.e. the relic re-fires if TurnNumber were ever 0
guards.rationale: Both codebases spell it `<= 1` (Akabeko.cs:25, akabeko.py:19), so any turn-0 behaviour is shared. Recorded because sibling relics in this batch are NOT consistent about it -- bag_of_preparation and big_mushroom use `TurnNumber > 1` / `!= 1` respectively -- and a future reader comparing them should know the asymmetry is in the source, not the port.
